SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rownum AS rnum, R.* FROM ( SELECT A.user_idx, A.coach_idx, A.nickname, A.photo, RANK.rank_name AS rank_name, ROUND(NVL(AVG(distinct rt.rating), 0), 1) AS rating, COUNT(distinct rt.content) AS review_count,
(SELECT CASE WHEN IS_CHAT = 'Y' THEN 'ACCEPTED' WHEN CHAT_APPLICANT = #{login_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND IS_CHAT = 'N' THEN 'APPLIED' WHEN CHAT_APPLICANT != #{login_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND IS_CHAT = 'N' THEN 'RECEIVED' ELSE 'NONE' END FROM MATCH WHERE (USER1_IDX = #{login_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND USER2_IDX = A.user_idx) OR (USER1_IDX = A.user_idx AND USER2_IDX = #{login_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER})) as chatStatus, (SELECT CASE WHEN IS_MATCH = 'Y' THEN 'ACCEPTED' WHEN MATCH_APPLICANT = #{login_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND IS_MATCH = 'N' THEN 'APPLIED' WHEN MATCH_APPLICANT != #{login_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND IS_MATCH = 'N' THEN 'RECEIVED' ELSE 'NONE' END FROM MATCH WHERE (USER1_IDX = #{login_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND USER2_IDX = A.user_idx) OR (USER1_IDX = A.user_idx AND USER2_IDX = #{login_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER})) as matchStatus
'NONE' as chatStatus, 'NONE' as matchStatus
FROM coach A
LEFT JOIN rank RANK ON A.point_score >= RANK.min_score AND (RANK.max_score IS NULL OR A.point_score < RANK.max_score) LEFT JOIN coach_provide B ON A.coach_idx = B.coach_idx JOIN minor_field MF ON B.minor_field_idx = MF.minor_field_idx LEFT JOIN coach_region C ON A.coach_idx = C.coach_idx LEFT JOIN user_hashtag UH ON A.user_idx = UH.user_idx LEFT JOIN user_hashtag_like UHL ON A.user_idx = UHL.user_idx LEFT JOIN hashtag H ON UH.hashtag_idx = H.hashtag_idx LEFT JOIN hashtag H ON UHL.hashtag_idx = H.hashtag_idx LEFT JOIN review_coach rt ON A.user_idx = rt.reviewee_idx
(A.nickname LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR NVL(H.TAGS, ' ') LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%') AND MF.major_field_idx = #{majorField} AND B.minor_field_idx = #{minorField} AND C.major_region_idx = #{majorRegion} AND C.minor_region_idx = #{minorRegion}
GROUP BY A.user_idx, A.coach_idx, A.nickname, A.photo, RANK.rank_name
ORDER BY rating DESC
ORDER BY review_count DESC
ORDER BY A.coach_idx DESC
) R WHERE rownum <= #{end} ) WHERE rnum >= #{start}

(SELECT LISTAGG(MF.MINOR_FIELD_NM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY MF.MINOR_FIELD_NM) FROM COACH_PROVIDE CP JOIN MINOR_FIELD MF ON CP.MINOR_FIELD_IDX = MF.MINOR_FIELD_IDX WHERE CP.COACH_IDX = A.coach_idx) AS minor_field_name,

(SELECT LISTAGG(MF_INT.MINOR_FIELD_NM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY MF_INT.MINOR_FIELD_NM) FROM COACH_INTEREST CI JOIN MINOR_FIELD MF_INT ON CI.MINOR_FIELD_IDX = MF_INT.MINOR_FIELD_IDX WHERE CI.COACH_IDX = A.coach_idx) AS minor_field_name2,
(SELECT LISTAGG(MAJOR_FIELD_CD, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY MAJOR_FIELD_CD) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT MAF_INT.MAJOR_FIELD_CD, CI2.COACH_IDX FROM COACH_INTEREST CI2 JOIN MINOR_FIELD MF_INT2 ON CI2.MINOR_FIELD_IDX = MF_INT2.MINOR_FIELD_IDX JOIN MAJOR_FIELD MAF_INT ON MF_INT2.MAJOR_FIELD_IDX = MAF_INT.MAJOR_FIELD_IDX ) DIS_INT WHERE DIS_INT.COACH_IDX = A.coach_idx) AS major_field_name2,

(SELECT CASE WHEN IS_MATCH = 'Y' THEN 'ACCEPTED' WHEN MATCH_APPLICANT = #{login_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND IS_MATCH = 'N' THEN 'APPLIED' WHEN MATCH_APPLICANT != #{login_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND IS_MATCH = 'N' THEN 'RECEIVED' ELSE 'NONE' END FROM MATCH WHERE (USER1_IDX = #{login_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND USER2_IDX = A.user_idx) OR (USER1_IDX = A.user_idx AND USER2_IDX = #{login_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER})) as matchStatus FROM coach A LEFT JOIN review_coach rt ON A.user_idx = rt.reviewee_idx LEFT JOIN rank R ON A.point_score >= R.min_score AND (R.max_score IS NULL OR A.point_score < R.max_score) WHERE A.user_idx = #{target_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER} GROUP BY A.user_idx, A.coach_idx, A.nickname, A.photo, A.intro, A.video, R.rank_name
